instrument_name: Utah Pub 14 Withholding Tax Guide Rev. 04/26 (Wayback 20260713) - re-read for part 1
figure_or_rule_carried: Method: Tax Commission schedules by pay frequency (1 weekly ... 8 daily): tax = taxable wages x 0.0445 less (base allowance - 1.3% x (wages - threshold)); e.g. weekly single base allowance 9, threshold 180; married 19 / 360. Certificate: federal Form W-4 only, no Utah form; "No subtraction is made for personal or other withholding allowances claimed on federal form W-4"; Utah taxable wages = wages subject to federal withholding (IRC 3401(a)). Code R865-9I-14(G) (Cornell mirror, tier C) only says use the Commission schedules; official rule host adminrules.utah.gov returned 404 and le.utah.gov is unreachable.

instrument_name: Code of Virginia 58.1-300 Incomes not subject to local taxation
figure_or_rule_carried: "No county, city, town or other political subdivision of this Commonwealth shall impose any tax or levy upon incomes, incomes being hereby segregated for state taxation only." (history to 2013, c. 766). No local wage tax in Virginia; employer withholding goes only to Virginia Tax (VA-5/VA-6).
